style.styleTitle: Personalised Heart Shaped Photo Couple's Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised heart shaped photo within a glass bauble. This makes a beautiful gift for any couple and is perfect for celebrating a first Christmas as a married couple with a wedding photo to display on their tree year after year. The photo is printed onto a layer of frosted acrylic, and below this there are two lines of personalised text, printed in a black font onto the same layer. This bauble also features a second smaller heart, made from a mirror acrylic overlaid onto the frosted acrylic and engraved with the year of your choosing. No text will be included/added as standard and so your personalisation will be engraved and printed exactly as entered. The bauble measures approximately 10 x 10 cm.
